-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvNode` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def isReadyChan (γ : NodeNames) (ch : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  isHandshake γ.readyc ch (readyP γ) iprop(True)

def propArg (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (Q : List EntryM → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(propIs γ d Q ∗ propAu1 γ d Q)

def (sealed) nodeDriver (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) (ds : List EntryM) (p : HardStateM) :
    IProp GF

theorem tickCred_split (bud : BudgetNames) (a b : Nat) : tickCred bud (a + b) ⊣⊢ tickCred bud a ∗
    tickCred bud b

theorem isNode_id [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) : isNode γ id n ⊢
    ⌜γ.id = id⌝

structure BudgetNames : Type where
  bound : GName

theorem budget_alloc_boot (Hb : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2) (E : CoPset) : ⊢ |={E}=> ∃ bud, inv
    budgetN (budgetInv bud) ∗ termLB bud (W64 1)

def reqOf (L : Option SnapLoan) (ds : List EntryM) : Option Nat :=
  match L with
  | none => some ds.length
  | some val => none

theorem readyP_take [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) (rd : Ready)
    (ds : List EntryM) (p : HardStateM) : ⊢ readyP γ rd -∗ nodeDriver γ id n ds p -∗ ∃ ce es ms p'
    L, readyDataL γ rd ds ce es ms p p' L ∗ nodeDriverBusy γ id n (dlvAfter ds ce L) es p' L ∗ dlvLb
    γ (dlvAfter ds ce L)

theorem budget_alloc (Hb : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2) (E : CoPset) : ⊢ |={E}=> ∃ bud, inv budgetN
    (budgetInv bud) ∗ termLB bud (W64 0)

def confstateS (γ : NodeNames) (c : ConfStateM) : Prop :=
  c.Voters'.Perm (elements γ.raft.reCfg) ∧
    (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ c.Learners' → ¬k ∈ γ.raft.reCfg) ∧
      c.VotersOutgoing' = [] ∧ c.LearnersNext' = [] ∧ c.AutoLeave' = false

theorem dlvLb_persistent (γ : NodeNames) (ds : List EntryM) : Persistent (dlvLb γ ds)

def (sealed) confcP (γ : NodeNames) (v : Loc) : IProp GF

def tickN : Namespace :=
  nroot.@"raft_tick"

def stepP (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (ml : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(netP γ id ml ∨ fwdP γ ml)

theorem nodeDriver_isNode [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) (ds :
    List EntryM) (p : HardStateM) : nodeDriver γ id n ds p ⊢ nodeDriver γ id n ds p ∗ isNode γ id n

theorem node_readState_data [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) (st :
    ReadStateM) (E : CoPset) : ⊢ isNode γ id n -∗ readStateOk γ.raft st ={E}=∗ readOk γ.raft
    st.RequestCtx' st.Index'

syntax tacticOpen_node_

def (sealed) isNode (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) : IProp GF

theorem isReadyChan_persistent (γ : NodeNames) (ch : Loc) : Persistent (isReadyChan γ ch)

def dlvAfter (d ce : List EntryM) : Option SnapLoan → List EntryM :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => d ++ ce
  | some l => l.dlv

def tickCred (_bud : BudgetNames) (n : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  ⧗n

theorem isNode_persistent (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) : Persistent (isNode γ id n)

def confstateOk (c : ConfStateM) (cfg : CfgM) : Prop :=
  c.Voters'.Perm (elements cfg.incoming) ∧
    c.VotersOutgoing'.Perm (elements cfg.outgoing) ∧
      c.Learners'.Perm (elements cfg.learners) ∧
        c.LearnersNext'.Perm (elements cfg.learnersNext) ∧ c.AutoLeave' = cfg.autoLeave

theorem budget_alloc_at (m : Nat) (hm : m ≤ 1) (Hb : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2) (E : CoPset) : ⊢
    |={E}=> ∃ bud, inv budgetN (budgetInv bud) ∗ monoNatLbOwn bud.bound m

theorem node_read_deposit [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) (c : List
    w8) (Qr : List EntryM → IProp GF) (L0 : List EntryM) : ⊢ isNode γ id n -∗ rdFresh γ.raft c -∗
    readAu γ.raft Qr -∗ isCommitted γ.raft L0 ={⊤}=∗ ∃ Lc, ⌜L0 <+: Lc⌝ ∗ readReq γ.raft c Lc ∗
    isRead γ.raft c Qr

theorem isNode_commitInv [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) : isNode γ
    id n ⊢ raftCommitInv γ.raft

def reqWit (γ : NodeNames) : Option Nat → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(True)
  | some k => iprop(∃ x, storFloor γ.stor x ∗ ⌜↑k ≤ uint.Z x⌝)

def (sealed) tickInv (γ : NodeNames) : IProp GF

def ready_countable : Pos.Countable Ready :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun r =>
      (r.SoftState', r.HardState', r.ReadStates', r.Entries', r.Snapshot', r.CommittedEntries', r.Messages', r.MustSync'))
    (fun p =>
      { SoftState' := p.fst, HardState' := p.snd.fst, ReadStates' := p.snd.snd.fst, Entries' := p.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        Snapshot' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, CommittedEntries' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        Messages' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, MustSync' := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    ⋯

def snapLoan_countable : Pos.Countable SnapLoan :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun l =>
      Pos.Countable.encode
        ((((((((((l.ptr, l.snap.Data'), l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.Voters'), l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.Learners'),
                      l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.VotersOutgoing'),
                    l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.LearnersNext'),
                  l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave'),
                l.snap.Metadata'.Index'),
              l.snap.Metadata'.Term'),
            l.fl),
          l.dlv))
    ⋯

def (sealed) readyP (γ : NodeNames) (rd : Ready) : IProp GF

theorem handshake_send_au_upd [package_sem : Assumptions] {V : Type} [Pos.Countable V] [ZeroVal V]
    [TypedPointsto V] {t : go.GoType} [IntoValTyped V t] (γc : ChanNames) (ch : Loc) (v : V) (P : V
    → IProp GF) (Q Φ : IProp GF) : ⊢ £ 1 ∗ £ 1 ∗ £ 1 -∗ isHandshake γc ch P Q -∗ |==> (P v ∗ ▷ (Q -∗
    Φ)) -∗ sendAu γc v Φ

def fwdP (γ : NodeNames) (ml : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ st,
      msgIn ml (DFrac.own 1) st ∗
        ⌜st.msg.Type' = MsgProp ∧ st.resps = []⌝ ∗
          isMessage γ.raft (absMsg MsgType.propose st.msg st.ents) ∗ [∗list] e ∈ st.ents, entTk γ.raft e)

def cfgM_countable : Pos.Countable CfgM :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun c => (c.incoming, c.outgoing, c.learners, c.learnersNext, c.autoLeave))
    (fun p =>
      { incoming := p.fst, outgoing := p.snd.fst, learners := p.snd.snd.fst, learnersNext := p.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        autoLeave := p.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    cfgM_countable._proof_1

theorem node_propose_ghost [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) (data :
    List w8) (Q : List EntryM → IProp GF) (E : CoPset) (HE1 : ↑(raftN γ.raft) ⊆ E) : ⊢ isNode γ id n
    -∗ ⌜data = []⌝ ∨ propArg γ.raft (entKey (W32 0) data) Q ={E}=∗ propData γ.raft (propEntryM data)
    ∗ entTk γ.raft (propEntryM data)

    (budgetInv bud) -∗ termLB bud t ={E}=∗ ⌜uint.Z t < 2 ^ 64 - 1⌝

    EntryM) (ms : List QMsg) (p p' : HardStateM) (L : Option SnapLoan) (H : γ.raft.reNoSnap = true ∨
    γ.mode.isDyn = true ∨ γ.snapIn = false) : readyDataL γ rd d ce es ms p p' L ⊢ ⌜L = none⌝ ∗
    readyData γ rd d ce es ms p p'

    γ.raft.reNoSnap = true ∨ γ.mode.isDyn = true ∨ γ.snapIn = false) : reqWit γ (reqOf none ds) ⊢ ∃
    x, storFloor γ.stor x ∗ ⌜↑ds.length ≤ uint.Z x⌝

theorem termLB_zero (bud : BudgetNames) : ⊢ |==> termLB bud (W64 0)

def rsDlv (rs : RNState) : List EntryM :=
  match rs.slent with
  | none => rs.delivered
  | some l => l.dlv

def budgetInv (bud : BudgetNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ M k, monoNatAuthOwn bud.bound 1 M ∗ ⧗k ∗ ⌜M ≤ k + 1 ∧ receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2⌝)

theorem node_ready_receive_ns [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n ch : Loc)
    (ds : List EntryM) (p : HardStateM) (H : γ.raft.reNoSnap = true ∨ γ.mode.isDyn = true ∨ γ.snapIn
    = false) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isReadyChan γ ch ∗ nodeDriver γ id n ds p -∗ (▷ ∀ rd, (∃ ce es ms p',
    readyData γ rd ds ce es ms p p' ∗ nodeDriverBusy γ id n (ds ++ ce) es p') -∗ Φ (intoVal rd,
    intoVal true)) -∗ WP ((chan.receive Ready.ty) (intoVal ch)) {{ Φ }}

def msgWithResult_countable : Pos.Countable msgWithResult :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun m => (m.m', m.result')) (fun p => { m' := p.fst, result' := p.snd }) ⋯

def budgetN : Namespace :=
  nroot.@"raft_budget"

theorem budget_spend (bud : BudgetNames) (t : w64) (E : CoPset) (HE : ↑budgetN ⊆ E) : ⊢ inv budgetN
    (budgetInv bud) -∗ tickCred bud 1 -∗ termLB bud t ={E}=∗ ⌜uint.Z t + 1 < 2 ^ 64 - 1⌝ ∗ termLB
    bud (t + W64 1)

theorem termLB_le (bud : BudgetNames) (t t' : w64) (h : uint.Z t' ≤ uint.Z t) : ⊢ termLB bud t -∗
    termLB bud t'

    List EntryM) (p' : HardStateM) (L : Option SnapLoan := none) : ⊢ nodeDriverBusy γ id n ds es p'
    L -∗ dlvLb γ ds

    List w8) (Q : List EntryM → IProp GF) (E : CoPset) (HE1 : ↑(raftN γ.raft) ⊆ E) : ⊢ isNode γ id n
    -∗ propFresh γ.raft d ={E}=∗ propIs γ.raft d Q

theorem netP_local [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (ml : Loc) (st : MsgSt)
    (Hty : st.msg.Type' = MsgTransferLeader ∨ st.msg.Type' = MsgForgetLeader ∨ st.msg.Type' =
    MsgUnreachable ∨ st.msg.Type' = MsgSnapStatus) (Ht : st.msg.Term' = W64 0) (He : st.ents = [])
    (Hc : st.ctx = []) (Hr : st.resps = []) (Hxt : st.msg.Type' = MsgTransferLeader →
    γ.raft.reNoXfer = false) : ⊢ msgIn ml DFrac.discard st -∗ termLB γ.bud (W64 0) -∗ rdCred γ.raft
    0 -∗ tickCred γ.bud 0 -∗ netP γ id ml

theorem isHandshake_isChan {V : Type} [Pos.Countable V] [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (γc :
    ChanNames) (ch : Loc) (P : V → IProp GF) (Q : IProp GF) : ⊢ isHandshake γc ch P Q -∗ isChan ch
    γc V

theorem node_committed_data [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) (l :
    List EntryM) (E : CoPset) (HE : ↑(raftN γ.raft) ⊆ E) : ⊢ isNode γ id n -∗ isCommitted γ.raft l
    ={E}=∗ ∃ ods, [∗list] e;o ∈ l;ods, entDataIs γ.raft e o

def (sealed) runCfg (γ : NodeNames) (rs : RNState) : IProp GF

def (sealed) advDep (γ : NodeNames) (rn : Loc) (id : w64) : IProp GF

theorem readyP_take_ns [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n : Loc) (rd : Ready)
    (ds : List EntryM) (p : HardStateM) (H : γ.raft.reNoSnap = true ∨ γ.mode.isDyn = true ∨ γ.snapIn
    = false) : ⊢ readyP γ rd -∗ nodeDriver γ id n ds p -∗ ∃ ce es ms p', readyData γ rd ds ce es ms
    p p' ∗ nodeDriverBusy γ id n (ds ++ ce) es p' ∗ dlvLb γ (ds ++ ce)

def readySnapData (γ : NodeNames) (rd : Ready) (d ce es : List EntryM) (ms : List QMsg) (p p' :
    HardStateM) (l : SnapLoan) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(entsRO rd.CommittedEntries' ce ∗
      isCommitted γ.raft (d ++ ce) ∗
        entsRO rd.Entries' es ∗
          ownSlice rd.Messages' (List.map QMsg.loc ms) (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            ([∗list] q ∈ ms,
                iprop(msgOwn q.loc (readyDq q.st) q.st ∗ isRaftMsg γ.raft γ.id q.st ∗ termLB γ.bud q.st.msg.Term')) ∗
              ([∗list] q ∈ ms, rdCred γ.raft (if q.st.msg.Type' = MsgReadIndex then 1 else 0)) ∗
                ([∗list] q ∈ ms, stTks γ.raft q.st) ∗
                  (∃ sts, readStatesPts rd.ReadStates' sts ∗ [∗list] st ∈ sts, readStateOk γ.raft st) ∗
                    (∃ h, hsOpt rd.HardState' h ∗ ⌜p' = phsNext p h⌝) ∗
                      hsWit γ.raft p' (d ++ ce).length ∗
                        softStateRO rd.SoftState' ∗
                          readyIdx γ.raft d ce es ∗
                            ⌜γ.snapIn = true ∧ γ.raft.reNoSnap = false ∧ γ.mode = RNMode.static⌝ ∗
                              ownSnapS l.ptr (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) l.snap ∗
                                isCommitted γ.raft l.dlv ∗
                                  snapLocal γ.raft γ.id l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∗
                                    ⌜l.ptr = rd.Snapshot' ∧
                                          ce = [] ∧
                                            d <+: l.dlv ∧
                                              d.length < l.dlv.length ∧
                                                l.dlv.length = (uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index').toNat ∧
                                                  0 < uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                                                    uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61 ∧
                                                      uint.Z l.fl ≤ uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                                                        LogIndicesOk (snapId l.snap) es⌝ ∗
                                      readyOut γ.stor es (some l))

theorem readyP_none [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (rd : Ready) (H : γ.raft.reNoSnap =
    true ∨ γ.mode.isDyn = true ∨ γ.snapIn = false) : readyP γ rd ⊢ ∃ d ce es ms p p', dghostVar
    γ.dlv (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) (d, p) ∗ dghostVar γ.rof (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) (d, ce, es, p',
    none) ∗ readyData γ rd d ce es ms p p' ∗ monoListLbOwn γ.dlm (d ++ ce)

theorem reqWit_persistent (γ : NodeNames) (q : Option Nat) : Persistent (reqWit γ q)

def advReceipt (st : Storage) (es : List EntryM) : Option SnapLoan → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => appendReceipt st es
  | some l => snapReceipt st l es

theorem rsDlv_none {rs : RNState} (h : rs.slent = none) : rsDlv rs = rs.delivered

def (sealed) advRet (γ : NodeNames) (rn : Loc) (id : w64) : IProp GF

def readyDataL (γ : NodeNames) (rd : Ready) (d ce es : List EntryM) (ms : List QMsg) (p p' :
    HardStateM) : Option SnapLoan → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => readyData γ rd d ce es ms p p'
  | some l => readySnapData γ rd d ce es ms p p' l

def ccState_countable : Pos.Countable CCState :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun c => (c.cfg, c.prs)) (fun p => { cfg := p.fst, prs := p.snd }) ccState_countable._proof_1

def termLB (bud : BudgetNames) (t : w64) : IProp GF :=
  monoNatLbOwn bud.bound (uint.nat t)

structure NodeNames : Type 1 where
  raft : RaftNames
  bud : BudgetNames
  stor : Storage
  propc : ChanNames
  recvc : ChanNames
  confc : ChanNames
  confstatec : ChanNames

  advancec : ChanNames

  done : ChanNames
  stop : ChanNames
  status : ChanNames
  dlv : GName
  rof : GName
  mode : RNMode
  dlm : GName
  cap : GName
  ccq : GName
  cam : GName
  req : GName

  snapIn : Bool

theorem runCfg_congr [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) {rs rs' : RNState} (hm : rs'.mode =
    rs.mode) (hc : rs'.capplied = rs.capplied) (hd : rs'.delivered = rs.delivered) (hf : rs'.flw =
    rs.flw) (hp : rs'.psnap = rs.psnap) (hs : rs'.slent = rs.slent) (hcfg : rs'.cfg = rs.cfg) :
    runCfg γ rs ⊢ runCfg γ rs'

theorem handshake_false_recv_au {V : Type} [Pos.Countable V] [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (γc :
    ChanNames) (ch : Loc) (Φ : V → Bool → IProp GF) : ⊢ £ 1 ∗ £ 1 -∗ isHandshake γc ch (fun x =>
    iprop(False)) iprop(True) -∗ recvAu γc V Φ

def (sealed) isAdvChan (γ : NodeNames) (rn : Loc) (id : w64) (ch : Loc) : IProp GF

theorem node_ready_receive [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (n ch : Loc) (ds :
    List EntryM) (p : HardStateM) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isReadyChan γ ch ∗ nodeDriver γ id n ds p -∗ (▷ ∀ rd, (∃
    ce es ms p' L, readyDataL γ rd ds ce es ms p p' L ∗ nodeDriverBusy γ id n (dlvAfter ds ce L) es
    p' L) -∗ Φ (intoVal rd, intoVal true)) -∗ WP ((chan.receive Ready.ty) (intoVal ch)) {{ Φ }}

def (sealed) advanceP (γ : NodeNames) (L : Option SnapLoan) : IProp GF

def readyData (γ : NodeNames) (rd : Ready) (d ce es : List EntryM) (ms : List QMsg) (p p' :
    HardStateM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(entsRO rd.CommittedEntries' ce ∗
      isCommitted γ.raft (d ++ ce) ∗
        entsRO rd.Entries' es ∗
          appendRight γ.stor es ∗
            ownSlice rd.Messages' (List.map QMsg.loc ms) (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              ([∗list] q ∈ ms,
                  iprop(msgOwn q.loc (readyDq q.st) q.st ∗ isRaftMsg γ.raft γ.id q.st ∗ termLB γ.bud q.st.msg.Term')) ∗
                ([∗list] q ∈ ms, rdCred γ.raft (if q.st.msg.Type' = MsgReadIndex then 1 else 0)) ∗
                  ([∗list] q ∈ ms, stTks γ.raft q.st) ∗
                    (∃ sts, readStatesPts rd.ReadStates' sts ∗ [∗list] st ∈ sts, readStateOk γ.raft st) ∗
                      (∃ h, hsOpt rd.HardState' h ∗ ⌜p' = phsNext p h⌝) ∗
                        hsWit γ.raft p' (d ++ ce).length ∗
                          softStateRO rd.SoftState' ∗ ⌜rd.Snapshot' = null⌝ ∗ readyIdx γ.raft d ce es)

theorem budget_step (bud : BudgetNames) (t1 t2 : w64) (P : Prop) [Decidable P] (E : CoPset) (HE :
    ↑budgetN ⊆ E) : ⊢ inv budgetN (budgetInv bud) -∗ termLB bud t1 -∗ termLB bud t2 -∗ tickCred bud
    (if P then 1 else 0) ={E}=∗ ⌜uint.Z t1 + 1 < 2 ^ 64 ∧ uint.Z t2 + 1 < 2 ^ 64⌝ ∗ ∃ tb, termLB bud
    tb ∗ ⌜(max (uint.Z t1) (uint.Z t2) + if P then 1 else 0) ≤ uint.Z tb⌝

def (sealed) nodeCfg (γ : NodeNames) (ca : Nat) (cfg : CCState) : IProp GF

theorem isAdvChan_persistent (γ : NodeNames) (rn : Loc) (id : w64) (ch : Loc) : Persistent
    (isAdvChan γ rn id ch)

def netP (γ : NodeNames) (id : w64) (ml : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ st,
      msgIn ml DFrac.discard st ∗
        ⌜NetMsgOk id st⌝ ∗
          ⌜(st.msg.Type' = MsgPreVote → γ.raft.reBoot ≠ []) ∧
                (st.msg.Type' = MsgTransferLeader → γ.raft.reNoXfer = false) ∧
                  (st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap → γ.snapIn = true)⌝ ∗
            (□
                ∀ ty,
                  ⌜mtypeOf st.msg.Type' = some ty⌝ -∗
                    ⌜ty ≠ MsgType.snap⌝ -∗ isMessage γ.raft (absMsg ty st.msg st.ents st.ctx)) ∗
              □
                  (⌜st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap⌝ -∗
                    ∃ sv scfg,
                      ⌜st.snap = some sv ∧ scfg = sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists ∧ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61⌝ ∗
                        isMessageC γ.raft (absSnap st.msg sv scfg) ∗
                          snapDataOk γ.raft sv.Metadata'.Index' sv.Data' ∗ snapLocal γ.raft id sv.Metadata'.Index') ∗
                termLB γ.bud st.msg.Term' ∗
                  rdCred γ.raft (if st.msg.Type' = MsgReadIndex then 1 else 0) ∗
                    tickCred γ.bud (if st.msg.Type' = MsgTimeoutNow then 1 else 0))
